en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a spa or bath complex with tall cylindrical columns, some incorporating a natural rock formation. Large vertical windows line the wall, letting in light. The lower margin contains printed captions in Greek and French. There is a Greek postage stamp depicting a man's portrait with a 2.50 denomination and postal cancellation marks overlapping the image.
